documents.title: Intimation Of Book Closure - Pursuant To Regulation 42 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Intimation Of 34Th Annual General Meeting To Be Held On Tuesday, September 29, 2026 And Book Closure.

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 along with the notice convening its 34th Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026. The document details the re-appointment of directors, including Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah as an Independent Director for a second term and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan as a Whole-time Director. It also outlines procedures for remote e-voting, video conferencing participation, and statutory disclosures.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed a significant latent demand in the small business segment for practical and powerful technology.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth validated our thesis that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.

demand_outlook.claim: There has been an unprecedented increase in the adoption of AI among small businesses globally.
demand_outlook.quote: The past year witnessed an unprecedented surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made significant investments in AI-powered platforms designed specifically for small businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support to lower barriers to adoption.

orders_capacity.claim: The digital ecosystem of dSpeedUp expanded to serve more than 1,000 merchants with high client retention.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

capital_allocation.claim: The company stated that as no dividend was declared for the year 2015-16, the transfer of unclaimed dividends and associated shares to the IEPF does not arise.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company has not declared any dividend for the year 2015-16, the transfer of the amount of dividend that remains unclaimed for a period of 7 years to the IEPF account and the shares on which dividends remain unpaid or unclaimed for a period of seven consecutive years or more to the Demat account of IEPF Authority does not arise;

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah is re-appointed as an Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan is re-appointed as a Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
